BiblicalUsage: A healing is the finished work, the cure itself, and Paul lists it among the gifts the Spirit gives to the church. In 1 Corinthians 12:9 he names the gifts of healing by the same Spirit, in 1 Corinthians 12:28 he sets healings among the ministries God placed in the church, and in 1 Corinthians 12:30 he asks, have all the gifts of healing, expecting the answer no.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe healing is a gift, not a right I can claim or a test of my faith. The Spirit gives it as he wills, and my part is to ask and to trust the Giver.
